summary: 橄榄能在较贫瘠、干旱的土地上结果，早期驯化地点仍有争议。文章用古代遗物和文献追踪橄榄油的饮食、仪式等用途，并说明人们怎样榨油、分离油水，连废液也有用处。
logic: 橄榄生长环境与驯化争议
各文明赋予橄榄油的用途

paragraphs.brief: 油橄榄适宜的生长条件
sentences: Olive oil is produced from the fruit of the olive tree, which is a member of the Oleaceae plant family.
橄榄油由木犀科油橄榄树的果实制成。
The trees require some cold weather during the year, but also tolerate hot, dry conditions, and do not like moisture when they are flowering.
油橄榄每年需要一段寒冷天气，也能耐受炎热干燥，开花时却不喜欢湿气。
They actually produce better when subjected to these stressful conditions, and as a result, olive trees have traditionally been grown on land where little else will survive.
这些看似严苛的条件反而有利于结果，所以油橄榄传统上种在其他作物难以存活的土地上。
paragraphs.gist: 油橄榄树需要一定的低温，又能忍受炎热干旱，开花时怕潮湿，反而能在别的作物难以生长的土地上取得好收成。

sentences: Archaeologists today are divided over exactly where the first domestication of the olive occurred: some say it was in the area which is now Iran, Syria, Jordan and Egypt, while others contend it was in mainland Greece or on the island of Crete.
考古学家仍争论油橄榄最初在哪里被驯化，有人认为在今天的伊朗、叙利亚、约旦和埃及一带，另一些人则指向希腊本土或克里特岛。
The one thing that can be said with certainty is that cultivation began at least 6,000 years ago and spread slowly westward across the lands bordering on the Mediterranean Sea.
可以肯定的是，栽培至少始于六千年前，并沿地中海沿岸缓慢向西传播。
Olive oil was used for a variety of purposes during these early times, including as a pharmacological ointment and in rituals for anointing royalty.
早期橄榄油用途很多，既用作药膏，也用于为王室成员行傅油礼。
paragraphs.gist: 橄榄最早在何处驯化仍有争论，但至少六千年前就已开始栽培，后来沿地中海向西传播，其油也被用作药膏和王室仪式用品。

paragraphs.brief: 橄榄树的宗教与政治价值
sentences: The ancient Greeks believed the olive tree was a priceless gift from the goddess Athena and used its oil in sacred religious rituals.
古希腊人相信橄榄树是雅典娜女神赐予的无价之宝，将橄榄油用于神圣仪式。
In fact, the Greek poet Homer called olive oil ‘liquid gold’, and during the 6th and 7th centuries BC, Greek law forbade the cutting down of olive trees and made it punishable by death.
事实上，希腊诗人霍默称橄榄油为“液体黄金”，在公元前6世纪和7世纪，希腊法律禁止砍伐橄榄树，并处以死刑。
The ancient Middle Eastern ruler King David valued his groves of olive trees and his olive oil warehouses so much that he posted guards around the clock to protect them.
远古的中东统治者大卫国王珍惜他的橄榄树和橄榄油仓库每天24小时派人保护他们
paragraphs.gist: 古希腊人把橄榄树视作雅典娜的礼物，甚至以死刑禁止砍伐，大卫王也派人日夜守卫树园和油库，可见其价值。

sentences: Over the years, olive oil developed other uses.
随着时间推移，人们开发出橄榄油的其他用途。
Its employment in cooking dates at least as far back as the 5th century BC, as described by the Greek philosopher Plato.
据希腊哲学家柏拉图所述，橄榄油用于烹饪至少可追溯至公元前五世纪。
Its use as an aid to beauty and health later became ingrained in many Mediterranean cultures.
后来，许多地中海文化都形成了用橄榄油美容保健的传统。
The Romans, for example, are said to have used generous amounts on their bodies to moisturise their skin after bathing.
例如据说罗马人沐浴后会在身上大量涂抹橄榄油，以滋润皮肤。
With the spread of the Roman Empire, olive oil became a major commodity, and its trade promoted commerce throughout the ancient world.
随着罗马帝国的扩张，橄榄油成为主要商品，其贸易促进了整个古代世界的商业。
It is generally believed that in the 1st–2nd centuries BC, olive trees were taken to North Africa and then to Spain, which was later to become the world’s largest producer of olive oil.
人们普遍认为，在公元前1至2世纪，橄榄树被运到北非，然后被运到西班牙，西班牙后来成为世界上最大的橄榄油生产国。
Artefacts found at various Mediterranean archaeological sites include olive oil storage vessels with olive plant residue still in them.
地中海各处考古遗址出土的文物包括储油容器，其中至今仍有橄榄植物残渣。

Historical evidence still in existence in the form of wall paintings and ancient manuscripts (including the works of the Roman naturalist and philosopher, Pliny the Elder) all record production techniques and the various uses of olive oil.
留存至今的壁画和古代手稿，包括罗马博物学家兼哲学家老普林尼的作品，都记录了橄榄油的生产技术和多种用途。
paragraphs.gist: 橄榄油由烹饪、护肤用品发展为罗马帝国的重要贸易品，储油容器、壁画和古籍至今仍留有生产及用途的证据。

paragraphs.brief: 古代压榨和分离橄榄油
sentences: Making olive oil in those early days was a laborious process accomplished without mechanisation.
在那些早期生产橄榄油是一个艰难的过程，没有机械化。
Processing or milling the fruit involved several distinct stages to extract the liquid.
加工或碾磨水果需要几个不同的阶段来提取液体。
The olives were harvested from the trees by hand or by beating the fruit from the trees with long sticks.
橄榄是用手或用长棍从树上打果实而从树上收获的。
The olives were then rinsed and crushed to separate out the large seed found in the centre of each.
然后，橄榄被冲洗和压碎，以分离在每颗橄榄的中心发现的大型种子。
The remaining seedless flesh was put in woven bags and pressed.
剩下的去核果肉装入编织袋中压榨。
Hot water was then poured over the bags to separate the oil from the solid bits of olive.
随后把热水浇过袋子，让油与橄榄固体残渣分离。
The liquid produced in this process, consisting of oil and water, was drained into stone basins or tanks, where it was allowed to settle and separate.
油水混合液流入石盆或储槽，静置等其分层。
In cold weather, a bit of salt was added to speed up the process.
在寒冷的天气中，加点盐来加快过程。
As much oil as possible was drawn off the water, but the result was still not pure oil.
人们尽量从水面取出浮油，但所得的油仍含有杂质。
Therefore, this impure mixture was allowed once more to settle in vats and then separated in order to refine the product.
因此还要让混合液在大缸里再次静置、分离，以进一步提纯。
paragraphs.gist: 古人手摘或打落橄榄，洗净去核后把果肉装袋压榨，再用热水、静置分层和反复澄清来分离并提纯油脂。

paragraphs.brief: 榨油废水的污染与用途
sentences: The waste water from the milling process, which is called amurca, is a bitter-tasting and foul-smelling liquid.
碾磨过程中产生的废水，即所谓的Amurca，是一种苦味和臭味的液体。
In many ancient civilisations it was often simply discarded, causing serious pollution because of its acidity and high salt content.
在许多古老文明中，它常常被简单地抛弃，由于酸性和高盐含量而造成严重污染。
However, in the Roman period it was regarded as a very useful substance.
但在罗马时期，人们认为这种废水十分有用。
When spread on surfaces, amurca forms a hard finish and therefore it was often applied to the floors of grain storage buildings where it hardened, keeping out water, mud and pests.
将其涂于物体表面会形成坚硬的涂层，因此人们常把它涂在粮仓地板上，硬化后可隔绝水、泥和害虫。
When boiled down, amurca was applied to leather to soften it so that it was easier to shape into articles of clothing and shoes.
浓缩煮沸后，还可涂在皮革上使其软化，便于做成衣物和鞋。
It could also be eaten by farm animals and was, in fact, fed to livestock suffering from malnutrition.
农场动物也可以食用它，实际上，它被喂养给营养不良的牲畜。
According to ancient texts, amurca was also utilised in moderate amounts by farmers as a fertiliser or as a pesticide, helping them to protect their crops from insects and even small rodents.
根据古老的文字，Amurca还被农民作为化肥或农药，适度地使用，帮助他们保护其作物不受昆虫甚至小鼠的伤害。
paragraphs.gist: 榨油废水 amurca 酸且含盐，随意排放会造成污染，但罗马人用它加固仓库地面、软化皮革，也用于饲养牲畜和保护作物。

items.en: In the cultivation of olives, a period without rain is advantageous.
items.zh: 在种植橄榄时，没有雨的时期是有利的。
items.why: “period without rain (无雨/干燥期)”e“dry conditions (干燥条件)”。且文本直接给出“produce better (产量更好)”,故为 TRUE。

items.en: The most fertile fields are usually chosen for growing olives.
items.zh: 最肥沃的田地通常被选作种植橄榄。
items.why: 橄榄树在贫瘠、别的作物难以生长的土地上反而表现更好，与“选择最肥沃的田地”相反。

items.en: In ancient Greece, the olive tree was said to have divine origins.
items.zh: 在古希腊，橄榄树据说有神圣的起源。
items.why: 古希腊人相信橄榄树是女神雅典娜的礼物，正对应其神圣起源。

items.en: Olive oil was more costly to buy in Greece than gold.
items.zh: 希腊的橄榄油比黄金更贵。
items.why: “liquid gold”是隐喻 (珍贵),文中没有任何与黄金价格比较的数据或表述，婚非同意也非否定，判 NOT GIVEN。

items.en: Plato mentions the use of olive oil in the preparation of food.
items.zh: 柏拉图提到在准备食物时使用橄榄油。
items.why: 题干的“preparation of food (备餐/烹饪) ”与原文“employment in cooking” 一致且指明“Plato”,故 TRUE。

items.en: North African farmers initially resisted the introduction of olive trees.
items.zh: 北非农民起初抵制引进橄榄树。
items.why: 文中没有任何关于“北非农民态度/抵制”的信息，判 NOT GIVEN。

items.en: olives are harvested by picking them or ________ the trees
items.zh: 收获橄榄时，可以直接采摘，也可以通过________树木使果实落下。
items.why: 回到对应内容“橄榄是用手或用长棍从树上打果实而从树上收获的”，再按题干要求写出答案。

items.en: olive flesh is placed in ________ and pressed
items.zh: 把橄榄果肉放入________中压榨。
items.why: 题型限 ONE WORD,与原词组最贴近的一词是 bags (若写“woven bags” 将超词数)。

items.en: resulting liquid is given time to settle and separate, and ________ is used to aid the process
items.zh: 让榨出的液体静置、分层，并加入________促进这一过程。
items.why: 回到对应内容“在寒冷的天气中，加点盐来加快过程”，再按题干要求写出答案。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

items.en: Amurca In ancient times, this waste liquid was usually thrown away, which led to ________.
items.zh: 古人通常直接倒掉称为 amurca 的榨油废液，由此造成了________。
items.why: 与题干“led to” 一致，对应名词 pollution。

items.en: when dried, created a hard surface, so used on ________ of certain buildings
items.zh: 这种废液干燥后会形成坚硬的表层，所以曾被用在一些建筑的________上。
items.why: 题干“of certain buildings”与原文“grain storage buildings (谷物储存建筑) ”一致，名词复数 floors。

items.en: used when making ________ into goods to wear
items.zh: 把________制成穿戴用品时，也会用到这种废液。
items.why: 笔记中的“into goods to wear (做成可穿之物)”提示答案应是上游材料 leather。

items.en: used on farms as a ________ to stop insects or animals from damaging crops
items.zh: 农场还把这种废液当作________，防止昆虫或其他动物破坏庄稼。
items.why: 题干明确“to stop insects or animals”,与“pesticide (农药/杀虫剂) ”精准对应 (而非 fertiliser)。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: 第 1 段 · 第 3 句
第 5 段 · 第 10 句
第 2 段 · 第 2 句
points: “liquid gold”是隐喻 (珍贵),文中没有任何与黄金价格比较的数据或表述，婚非同意也非否定，判 NOT GIVEN。
笔记中的“into goods to wear (做成可穿之物)”提示答案应是上游材料 leather。
clauses: Archaeologists today are divided over exactly where the first domestication of the olive occurred: some say it was in the area which is now Iran, Syria, Jordan and Egypt, ….
连接词 while 引出“while others contend it was in mainland Greece or on the island of Crete”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。
The one thing … is that cultivation began at least 6,000 years ago and spread slowly westward across the lands bordering on the Mediterranean Sea.
“that can be said with certainty”修饰前面的 thing。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 that 时，回看 thing，再把修饰信息接回主句。
